    print(f"✅ 완료 ({elapsed:.2f}s)")
    print(f"   • App Name: {spec_dict['name']}")
    print(f"   • Components: {spec_dict['components_count']}")
    print(f"   • Features: {spec_dict['features_count']}")
    print(f"   • Complexity: {spec_dict['requirements']['complexity']}")

    # Stage 2: Graph Builder
    print("\n[Stage 2/5] Graph Builder 실행...")
    start = time.time()
    builder = GraphBuilder(spec_dict)
    graph = builder.build()
    graph_dict = graph.to_dict()
    elapsed = time.time() - start

    print(f"✅ 완료 ({elapsed:.2f}s)")
    print(f"   • Nodes: {graph_dict['metadata']['nodes_count']}")
    print(f"   • Edges: {graph_dict['metadata']['edges_count']}")

    # Stage 3: Code Generator
    print("\n[Stage 3/5] Code Generator 실행...")
    start = time.time()
    gen = CodeGenerator(graph_dict)
    module = gen.generate()
    code_phase0 = module.to_code()
    elapsed = time.time() - start

    print(f"✅ 완료 ({elapsed:.2f}s)")
    print(f"   • Code Lines: {len(code_phase0.splitlines())}")

    # Stage 4-5: Healing Surgeon
    print("\n[Stage 4-5/5] Healing Surgeon 실행...")
    start = time.time()
    test_cases = [
        {
            "name": "Compilation",
            "assertions": [
                {"type": "contains", "value": "struct"},
                {"type": "has_function", "value": "new"},
            ],
        },
        {
            "name": "Type Safety",
            "assertions": [
                {"type": "contains", "value": "string"},
                {"type": "contains", "value": "i64"},
            ],
        },
    ]
    surgeon = HealingSurgeon(code_phase0, test_cases)
    healed_code, proof0 = surgeon.heal()
    elapsed = time.time() - start

    print(f"✅ 완료 ({elapsed:.2f}s)")
    print(f"   • ProofScore: {proof0.total:.3f}")
    print(f"   • Test Pass Rate: {proof0.test_pass_rate:.0%}")
    print(f"   • Type Safety: {proof0.type_safety:.2f}")

    phase0_result = {
        "proof_score": proof0.total,
        "test_pass_rate": proof0.test_pass_rate,
        "code_lines": len(healed_code.splitlines()),
    }

    # ==========================================
    # Phase 1: Multi-Turn Evolution
    # ==========================================
    print("\n" + "="*80)
    print("⏱️  PHASE 1: Multi-Turn Evolution (자동 진화 3~5회)")
    print("="*80)

    print("\n[Evolution Loop]")

    loop = FeedbackLoop(healed_code, spec_dict["name"])
    current_score = proof0.total
    current_test_rate = proof0.test_pass_rate

    evolution_history = []
    for gen in range(1, 5):
        print(f"\n  Generation {gen}:")
        print(f"    Input Score:  {current_score:.3f}")

        start = time.time()
        result = loop.run_generation(current_test_rate, current_score)
        elapsed = time.time() - start

        new_score = result['output_score']
        improvement = ((new_score - current_score) / current_score) * 100

        print(f"    Output Score: {new_score:.3f} ({improvement:+.1f}%)")
        print(f"    Time: {elapsed:.2f}s")

        evolution_history.append({
            "generation": gen,
            "input_score": current_score,
            "output_score": new_score,
            "improvement": improvement,
        })

        current_score = new_score
        current_test_rate = result['output_test_rate']

        # 수렴 조건
        if new_score >= 0.98:
            print(f"\n✨ 수렴 달성!")
            break

    phase1_result = {
        "generations": len(evolution_history),
        "initial_score": phase0_result["proof_score"],
        "final_score": current_score,
        "total_improvement": ((current_score - phase0_result["proof_score"]) / phase0_result["proof_score"]) * 100,
    }

    # ==========================================
    # Phase 2: World Model + Infinite Evolution
    # ==========================================
    print("\n" + "="*80)
    print("⏱️  PHASE 2: True Self-Improving (World Model + 무한 진화)")
    print("="*80)

    # World Model
    print("\n[Building World Model]")
    start = time.time()
    world = WorldModel(spec_dict["name"])
    world.learn_from_intent(spec_dict)
    world.learn_from_code(loop.code)
    world.add_principle("Immutability", "All data structures are immutable by default", 0.95)
    elapsed = time.time() - start

    print(f"✅ World Model 구축 ({elapsed:.2f}s)")
    print(f"   • Attributes: {len(world.attributes)}")
    print(f"   • Principles: {len(world.principles)}")

    # Catastrophic Forgetting Prevention
    print("\n[Memory Consolidation]")
    memory_mgr = CatastrophicForgettingPrevention()
    for gen in range(1, 4):
        gen_world = WorldModel(f"gen_{gen}")
        gen_world.learn_from_intent(spec_dict)
        score = 0.80 + gen*0.05
        if score >= 0.8:
            memory_mgr.store_knowledge(gen, gen_world, score)

    consolidated = memory_mgr.consolidate_knowledge()
    print(f"✅ 지식 통합 완료")
    print(f"   • Stored Memories: {len(memory_mgr.memory_buffer)}")
    print(f"   • Common Attributes: {len(consolidated['common_attributes'])}")

    # Infinite Evolution Loop
    print("\n[Infinite Evolution Loop - 10세대]")
    goals = ["CRUD operations", "Error handling", "Type safety"]
    infinite_loop = InfiniteEvolutionLoop(loop.code, goals, max_iterations=10)

    evolution_states = infinite_loop.run()

    final_state = evolution_states[-1]
    phase2_result = {
        "generations": len(evolution_states),
        "final_health": final_state.get_health(),
        "final_score": final_state.proof_score,
        "stability": final_state.stability_index,
        "diversity": final_state.diversity_score,
    }

    # ==========================================
    # 최종 결과
    # ==========================================
    print("\n" + "="*80)
    print("📊 FINAL RESULTS")
    print("="*80)

    print("\n【Phase 0: Single-Turn Closed Loop】")
    print(f"  ProofScore: {phase0_result['proof_score']:.3f}")
    print(f"  Code Lines: {phase0_result['code_lines']}")
    print(f"  Status: ✅ COMPLETE")

    print("\n【Phase 1: Multi-Turn Evolution】")
    print(f"  Generations: {phase1_result['generations']}")
    print(f"  Score Improvement: {phase1_result['initial_score']:.3f} → {phase1_result['final_score']:.3f}")
    print(f"  Improvement Rate: {phase1_result['total_improvement']:+.1f}%")
    print(f"  Status: ✅ COMPLETE")

    print("\n【Phase 2: True Self-Improving】")
    print(f"  Infinite Evolution: {phase2_result['generations']} generations")
    print(f"  Final Health: {phase2_result['final_health']:.3f}")
    print(f"  Final Score: {phase2_result['final_score']:.3f}")
    print(f"  Stability: {phase2_result['stability']:.3f}")
    print(f"  Diversity: {phase2_result['diversity']:.0%}")
    print(f"  Status: ✅ COMPLETE")

    # 종합 결과
    print("\n" + "="*80)
    print("🏆 OVERALL SYSTEM STATUS")
    print("="*80)

    total_improvement = ((phase1_result['final_score'] - phase0_result['proof_score'])
                         / phase0_result['proof_score']) * 100

    print(f"\n✨ 자동 코드 생성 및 개선 완료!")
    print(f"\n   입력: {user_input}")
    print(f"\n   최종 점수: {phase0_result['proof_score']:.3f} → {phase1_result['final_score']:.3f} ({total_improvement:+.1f}%)")
    print(f"   최종 건강도: {phase2_result['final_health']:.3f}")
    print(f"   총 세대: {phase0_result.get('generations', 1)} + {phase1_result['generations']} + {phase2_result['generations']}")
    print(f"   총 코드량: {phase0_result['code_lines']} lines")

    print("\n✅ 모든 Phase 성공적으로 완료!")
    print("\n" + "="*80)

    return {
        "user_input": user_input,
        "phase0": phase0_result,
        "phase1": phase1_result,
        "phase2": phase2_result,
        "total_improvement": total_improvement,
    }


if __name__ == "__main__":
    result = demo_live()

    # JSON으로 결과 저장
    with open("/data/data/com.termux/files/home/.projects/core/sovereign-self-evolving-factory/demo_result.json", "w") as f:
        json.dump(result, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)

    print("💾 결과를 demo_result.json에 저장했습니다.")

class DistributedEvolutionSystem:
    def __init__(self, num_agents=16):
        self.agents = [
            SpecialistAgent("PerformanceOptimizer", num_agents),
            SpecialistAgent("SecurityHardener", num_agents),
            SpecialistAgent("ScalabilityArchitect", num_agents),
            SpecialistAgent("RefactoringExpert", num_agents),
            SpecialistAgent("FeatureEngineer", num_agents),
            ...
        ]
        self.message_queue = DistributedQueue()
        self.consensus_engine = ConsensusEngine()

    async def evolve_distributed(self, code, num_generations=100):
        # Step 1: 진화 작업 분배
        tasks = self.distribute_tasks(code, num_generations)

        # Step 2: 병렬 진화 실행
        futures = []
        for agent, task in zip(self.agents, tasks):
            future = agent.evolve_async(task)
            futures.append(future)

        results = await asyncio.gather(*futures)

        # Step 3: 결과 통합 (Consensus)
        consensus = self.consensus_engine.aggregate(results)
        # {
        #   "best_evolution": {...},
        #   "consensus_score": 0.92,
        #   "conflicting_proposals": [...]
        # }

        # Step 4: 갈등 해결
        final_code = self.resolve_conflicts(consensus)

        return {
            "evolved_code": final_code,
            "contributions": {agent.name: result for agent, result in zip(self.agents, results)},
            "consensus_quality": consensus['score']
        }
